check_description: SHAP features expose raw training data
finding: PASS — Phase 10 SHAP importance CSV exposes feature names and aggregate SHAP values only. No individual training records exposed.
mitigation: SHAP values are aggregate importance scores across training set. Not individual record SHAP values.

finding: PASS — XGBoost model artifact (.pkl) is not served via any API endpoint. Only prediction outputs are returned.
mitigation: Model artifact stored on server-side only.

check_description: Training data records returned in API responses
finding: PASS — No API endpoint returns raw training events. Aggregate statistics and model outputs only.
mitigation: No endpoint exposes cybercrime_events or raw event records.

check_description: Alert responses expose individual victim information
finding: PASS — safe_fields whitelist applied in analyst_routes.py. Only analytical fields (severity|risk_score|alert_type|status) returned.
mitigation: Whitelist approach ensures only pre-approved fields are returned.

finding: PASS — Location data is hotspot centroid (aggregate cluster coordinate) — not individual address. No street address stored.
mitigation: Phase 14 DBSCAN produces cluster centroids — not individual event locations in alert responses.

finding: PARTIAL — Analyst-controlled field. System cannot validate note content at runtime in prototype.
mitigation: UI warning displayed. API docstring warns. Training required for production deployment. Runtime PII detection recommended for production.

check_description: Evidence reference contains sensitive financial data
finding: PARTIAL — Reference field is analyst-controlled. System validates type but not reference string content.
mitigation: API docstring explicitly warns against including account numbers|PINs|CVVs|OTPs. UI warning displayed.

finding: PASS — Token is returned in login response body only. Not logged by audit system. FastAPI default access log may log Authorization header in some configurations.
mitigation: Disable request header logging in production. Use HTTPS to prevent network interception.

finding: PASS — log_audit() only accepts safe string fields. Request body and credentials never passed to audit.
mitigation: Backend function signature prevents sensitive data from entering audit log.

finding: PASS — analyst_routes.py does not import or expose database/crud.py event queries. Only alert and prediction summary data accessed.
mitigation: analyst_routes.py is isolated from raw event storage.

check_description: SHAP feature names reveal model training schema
finding: LOW — Feature names (e.g. previous_activity_by_crime_category) reveal model feature schema. Acceptable for analytical interface.
mitigation: Feature names are in phase10_global_shap_importance.csv which is an authorized analytical output. Acceptable for analyst use.

check_description: Demo data might be confused with real data
finding: PASS — All demo records contain [SYNTHETIC DEMO] marker. UI displays SYNTHETIC DEMO and PROTOTYPE badges prominently.
mitigation: Multiple layers of labeling prevent confusion.

check_description: Hashed passwords returned in user query
finding: PASS — AnalystUser queries never return hashed_password field. UserRead schema excludes it.
mitigation: UserRead Pydantic schema does not include hashed_password field.

check_description: Analyst modifies JWT to claim SUPERVISOR role
finding: PASS — JWT tokens are HS256 signed with server-side secret. Modification invalidates signature → 401.
mitigation: JWTError caught in _decode_token(). Invalid signature returns 401.

check_description: Default JWT secret is weak or known
finding: REVIEW REQUIRED — Default secret contains obvious warning text but is technically predictable.
mitigation: CRITICAL: Change ANALYST_JWT_SECRET environment variable before production deployment.

check_description: Investigation API returns data from other investigation IDs
finding: PASS — Each investigation query filters by investigation_id. get_investigation() returns None for non-matching IDs → 404.
